description: Plan-mode gates for ExitPlanMode. The former review gate (exit-plan-mode-gate.sh) was removed 2026-07-26: it duplicated plan-oversight/soft_exit.py, which gates ExitPlanMode on the same condition but keyed by plan content hash rather than slug+mtime, and fails open rather than hard-blocking. PostToolUse renames the `.review-ready-<slug>` sentinel review-plan writes to `.exited-<slug>`. This rename is load-bearing: plan-unknowns-gate.py Stage 1 tests for `.review-ready-<slug>`, so the rename is what re-arms that check for the next plan revision. Without it the sentinel persists and Stage 1 reads as permanently satisfied for that slug. PostToolUse also emits an advisory nudge to invoke /schedule-plan-tasks. The primary PreToolUse gate (plan-unknowns-gate.py) runs a 3-stage plan-review state machine, each stage failing open: (1) a soft review-plan nudge (hard under CLAUDE_PLAN_REQUIRE_REVIEW=1); (2) a Codex (OpenAI CLI, read-only sandbox) unknowns audit that blocks until an '## Open Unknowns' section exists and tags bullets needing active go-find-out research with [investigate]; (3) a closed-loop investigation gate — when agentic unknowns are tagged, it blocks until /investigate-plan has run (proven by a host `.investigated-<slug>` sentinel) or the user waives via /waive-investigation, and fails open when the hermes container is down. plan-review-cleanup.py (PostToolUse) clears the investigation sentinels after a successful exit. Degrades to a self-audit instruction when the codex CLI is unavailable; opt out with CLAUDE_PLAN_UNKNOWNS_GATE=0.

hooks.statusMessage: Codex auditing plan for unresolved unknowns...
